deals: select d.pc_0012_id as id, d.name, d.stage, s.label as stage_label, coalesce(s.is_closed, false) as is_closed, coalesce(s.is_won, false) as is_won, d.amount, d.currency, d.amount_base, d.weighted_amount, d.pwin, d.close_date, d.customer_type, d.customer_type__label as customer_type_label, d.product_category, d.product_category__label as category_label, d.region__label as region, d.contract_vehicle__label as contract_vehicle, d.loss_reason__label as loss_reason, d.next_step, d.bant_total, d.created_at, (select c.name from associations a join companies c on c.pc_0011_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'deals' and a.other_object = 'companies' and a.record_id = d.pc_0012_id order by c.name limit 1) as company, (select (current_date - max(h.changed_at)::date) from property_history h where h.object = 'deals' and h.property = 'stage' and h.record_id = d.pc_0012_id) as days_in_stage from deals d left join property_options s on s.object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and s.property = 'stage' and s.api_value = d.stage where d.pipeline = 'defense'
stages: select api_value, label, is_closed, is_won from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and property = 'stage' and record_status = 'active' and 'defense' = any(parent_values) order by display_order
options: select property, api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0012' and property in ('customer_type', 'product_category') and record_status = 'active' order by property, display_order
contacts: select coalesce(customer_type, '') as customer_type, count(*) as n, count(*) filter (where created_at >= now() - interval '90 days') as new_90d from contacts group by 1
events: select e.pc_0060_id as id, e.name, e.start_at, e.event_type__label as event_type, count(p.pc_0061_id) as people, count(p.pc_0061_id) filter (where p.priority = 'hot') as hot, count(p.pc_0061_id) filter (where p.priority = 'warm') as warm, count(p.pc_0061_id) filter (where coalesce(p.follow_up_status, 'pending') = 'pending') as pending, count(p.pc_0061_id) filter (where p.follow_up_status = 'done') as done from marketing_events e left join associations a on a.object = 'marketing_events' and a.other_object = 'marketing_event_participations' and a.record_id = e.pc_0060_id left join marketing_event_participations p on p.pc_0061_id = a.other_record_id group by e.pc_0060_id, e.name, e.start_at, e.event_type__label order by e.start_at desc nulls last
activity: select kind, to_char(date_trunc('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') as month, count(*) as n from (select 'tasks' as kind, created_at from tasks union all select 'calls', created_at from calls union all select 'notes', created_at from notes union all select 'emails', created_at from emails union all select 'quotes', created_at from quotes union all select 'partnerships', created_at from partnerships union all select 'deals', created_at from deals where pipeline = 'defense') x where created_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '11 months' group by kind, month order by month, kind
ts_events: select e.pc_0060_id as id, e.name, e.start_at from marketing_events e order by e.start_at desc nulls last, e.name

ts_people.sql: select p.pc_0061_id as id, p.priority, p.priority__label as priority_label, p.follow_up_status, p.follow_up_status__label as status_label, p.follow_up_date, p.notes, p.created_at, ct.contact_id, ct.contact, ct.job_title, ct.email, ct.phone, co.company, ev.event_id, ev.event from marketing_event_participations p left join lateral (select c.pc_0010_id as contact_id, c.name as contact, c.job_title, c.email, c.phone from associations a join contacts c on c.pc_0010_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'marketing_event_participations' and a.other_object = 'contacts' and a.record_id = p.pc_0061_id limit 1) ct on true left join lateral (select x.pc_0011_id as company_id, x.name as company from associations a join companies x on x.pc_0011_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'contacts' and a.other_object = 'companies' and a.record_id = ct.contact_id order by x.name limit 1) co on true left join lateral (select e.pc_0060_id as event_id, e.name as event from associations a join marketing_events e on e.pc_0060_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'marketing_event_participations' and a.other_object = 'marketing_events' and a.record_id = p.pc_0061_id limit 1) ev on true where (:event is null or ev.event_id = :event) and (p.priority is not null or p.follow_up_status is not null) order by p.follow_up_date nulls last, p.created_at desc limit 2000

ts_statuses: select property, api_value, label from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0061' and property in ('priority', 'follow_up_status') and record_status = 'active' order by property, display_order
